errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart's title as "Umfrage Gründungsbarrieren," which is the figure caption from the paper. The actual title displayed on the chart is "alle Befragten mit Antwort ja (in %)".

The description interprets the categories as "Barrieren" (barriers). This is an unsubstantiated interpretation not present in the chart's labels. One of the categories, "Zutrauen" (confidence), does not logically fit the definition of a barrier, making this interpretation misleading.
